## ContextView.once() method

The "unbind" event is emitted a new binding is removed from the view.

**Signature:**

```typescript
once(eventName: 'unbind', listener: <V>(event: ContextViewEvent<V> & {
        cachedValue?: V;
    }) => void): this;
```
